subject.title: [Bug]: tools/sandbox: MEDIA_MAX_BYTES (5 MB) is hardcoded and not user-configurable

question: Should OpenClaw expose or reuse a bounded operator-configurable cap for generic media-store and sandbox staging, or keep the 5 MiB generic cap while allowing only narrow channel/document exceptions?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but the broad fix changes resource-limit configuration and sandbox/file-exposure behavior across core media paths.

options.title: Approve Bounded Core Cap
options.body: Use one documented bounded cap contract across media store, sandbox staging, chat preflight, and reply-media defaults with schema/help/docs and over-limit regression coverage.

options.title: Land Narrow Exceptions Only
options.body: Keep the generic 5 MiB cap and approve focused exceptions only where downstream channel limits and real proof justify them.

options.title: Keep Current Cap Intentionally
options.body: Document the 5 MiB generic staging cap as the supported safety default and close the broader configurability request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Core Cap
recommendation.body: Use one documented bounded cap contract across media store, sandbox staging, chat preflight, and reply-media defaults with schema/help/docs and over-limit regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans core media, sandbox staging, and security/default policy, and steipete has the strongest related history signal.
